name: Nestorius
role: Archbishop of Constantinople from c. 428 to 431
contribution: An early Christian prelate who served as Archbishop of Constantinople from 10 April 428 to 11 July 431.

checks.lead: Nestorius of Constantinople (; Ancient Greek: Νεστόριος; Syriac: ܡܪܝ ܢܣܛܘܪܝܣ, Mār Nesṭōrīs;  c. 386 – c. 451) was an early Christian prelate who served as Archbishop of Constantinople from 10 April 428 to 11 July 431. He was a Christian theologian from the Catechetical School of Antioch, and several of his teachings in the fields of Christology and Mariology were seen as controversial and heretical, causing major disputes.
